results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Coverage of Professor Fabio Giglietto's study analyzing Meta's algorithms and their impact on elections, showing a 72% reduction in Facebook visibility for Italian parliamentarians alongside increased reach for extremist accounts.

results.title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei. Pd e FdI verso una legge bipartisan sulle piattaforme
results.snippet: News article detailing research by Fabio Giglietto from the University of Urbino on how Meta's recommendation algorithms penalize official democratic representatives while amplifying fringe political actors.

results.title: Meno contenuti politici nei feed, la stretta di Meta è stata meno efficace contro gli estremisti
results.snippet: Il Sole 24 ORE reports on Fabio Giglietto's investigation into Meta's political content suppression policies and their unintended consequences on social media visibility.

results.title: Algoritmi Meta, più spazio agli estremisti e meno alla politica ufficiale
results.snippet: Article citing Fabio Giglietto's study on over 2.5 million Facebook posts, examining how platform recommendation systems impact democratic institutions and public opinion.
